ucs.title: [LLM] MuddyWater RMM-tool deployment chain — spear-phish ZIP/PDF dropping Atera/ScreenConnect/RemoteUtilities/Syncro installer
ucs.description: Hunts MuddyWater (Mango Sandstorm / TA450 / Static Kitten) characteristic post-2022 pivot from custom malware to legitimate remote-management tools delivered via spear-phishing. Catches Atera, ConnectWise/ScreenConnect, RemoteUtilities (rutserv.exe / rfusclient.exe), Syncro and AnyDesk installers spawned from archive-utility / browser / Outlook / PDF-reader parents — the exact chain documented by Microsoft, Deep Instinct, and Group-IB across MuddyWater Israeli, Saudi and US-municipality intrusions in 2023-2025.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("outlook.exe","explorer.exe","winrar.exe","7zg.exe","7zfm.exe","msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","acrord32.exe","foxit.exe") AND (Processes.process_name IN ("msiexec.exe","AteraAgent.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientSetup.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","Syncro.Installer.exe","AnyDesk.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*atera*","*screenconnect*","*connectwise*","*remoteutilities*","*rutserv*","*syncro*","*anydesk*","*rport.exe*")) by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where match(lower(process), "atera|screenconnect|connectwise|remoteutilities|rutserv|rfusclient|syncro|anydesk|rport") | where NOT match(user, "(?i)\\$$|^(system|local service|network service)$") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let RmmTokens = dynamic(["atera","screenconnect","connectwise","remoteutilities","rutserv","rfusclient","syncro","anydesk","rport.exe","action1","meshcentral"]);
let RmmInstallers = dynamic(["ateraagent.exe","screenconnect.clientsetup.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","syncro.installer.exe","anydesk.exe"]);
let LureParents = dynamic(["winrar.exe","7zg.exe","7zfm.exe","explorer.exe","outlook.exe","msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","acrord32.exe","foxit.exe","foxitphantompdf.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (LureParents)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| where FileName in~ (RmmInstallers)
    or (FileName =~ "msiexec.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any (RmmTokens))
    or (FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any (RmmTokens))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentFile = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildFile  = FileName,
          ChildCmd   = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256, InitiatingProcessFolderPath
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let RmmTokens = dynamic(["atera","screenconnect","connectwise","remoteutilities","rutserv","rfusclient","syncro","anydesk","rport.exe","action1","meshcentral"]);
let RmmInstallers = dynamic(["ateraagent.exe","screenconnect.clientsetup.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","syncro.installer.exe","anydesk.exe"]);
let LureParents = dynamic(["winrar.exe","7zg.exe","7zfm.exe","explorer.exe","outlook.exe","msedge.exe","chrome.exe","firefox.exe","acrord32.exe","foxit.exe","foxitphantompdf.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ChildName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend ParentName = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ParentName in (LureParents)
| where Account !endswith "$"
| where ChildName in (RmmInstallers)
    or (ChildName == "msiexec.exe" and CommandLine has_any (RmmTokens))
    or (ChildName in ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe") and CommandLine has_any (RmmTokens))
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: MuddyWater RMM Tool Deployed from Spear-Phish Lure Parent
id: 9c9f1a2e-7bb1-4a6e-a3c2-d8f3a51e3a8e
status: experimental
description: Detects MuddyWater (Mango Sandstorm / TA450) tradecraft of dropping legitimate RMM installers (Atera, ScreenConnect, RemoteUtilities, Syncro, AnyDesk) via spear-phish archive / PDF / browser lures.
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent_lure:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\winrar.exe'
      - '\7zg.exe'
      - '\7zfm.exe'
      - '\explorer.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\acrord32.exe'
      - '\foxit.exe'
  rmm_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\AteraAgent.exe'
      - '\ScreenConnect.ClientSetup.exe'
      - '\ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe'
      - '\rutserv.exe'
      - '\rfusclient.exe'
      - '\Syncro.Installer.exe'
      - '\AnyDesk.exe'
  rmm_in_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'atera'
      - 'screenconnect'
      - 'connectwise'
      - 'remoteutilities'
      - 'rutserv'
      - 'syncro'
      - 'anydesk'
      - 'rport.exe'
  condition: parent_lure and (rmm_image or rmm_in_cmd)
fields:
  - ParentImage
  - Image
  - CommandLine
  - User
falsepositives:
  - Sanctioned MSP onboarding pushing RMM agents via email
level: high
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1566.001
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1219.002
  - attack.g0069
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\winrar.exe OR *\WinRAR.exe OR *\7zg.exe OR *\7zFM.exe OR *\explorer.exe OR *\Explorer.EXE OR *\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\outlook.exe OR *\msedge.exe OR *\chrome.exe OR *\firefox.exe OR *\AcroRd32.exe OR *\Foxit.exe) (@Image:(*\AteraAgent.exe OR *\ateraagent.exe OR *\ScreenConnect.ClientSetup.exe OR *\ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe OR *\rutserv.exe OR *\rfusclient.exe OR *\Syncro.Installer.exe OR *\AnyDesk.exe OR *\anydesk.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*atera* OR *Atera* OR *screenconnect* OR *ScreenConnect* OR *connectwise* OR *ConnectWise* OR *remoteutilities* OR *RemoteUtilities* OR *rutserv* OR *syncro* OR *Syncro* OR *anydesk* OR *AnyDesk* OR *rport.exe*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/(winrar|7zg|7zfm|explorer|outlook|msedge|chrome|firefox|acrord32|foxit|foxitphantompdf)\.exe/i
| ImageFileName=/(ateraagent|screenconnect\.clientsetup|screenconnect\.windowsclient|rutserv|rfusclient|syncro\.installer|anydesk|msiexec|powershell|cmd)\.exe$/i
| (ImageFileName=/(ateraagent|screenconnect|rutserv|rfusclient|syncro|anydesk)\.exe$/i OR regex("(?i)(atera|screenconnect|connectwise|remoteutilities|rutserv|rfusclient|syncro|anydesk|rport\.exe)", field=CommandLine))
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), collect([CommandLine, SHA256HashData])])
| sort(firstSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: MuddyWater is uniquely characterised by abandoning custom implants in favour of pre-installed legitimate RMM tools — Microsoft's Mango Sandstorm reporting, Deep Instinct's PhonyC2/MuddyC2Go research, and Group-IB's TA450 coverage all anchor this exact chain: weaponised archive or PDF lure → user-initiated MSI / EXE → AteraAgent / ScreenConnect / RemoteUtilities / Syncro. Generic 'RMM detected' rul

ucs.title: [LLM] MuddyWater PowGoop loader — GoogleUpdate.exe DLL side-loading goopdate.dll outside Program Files spawning PowerShell
ucs.description: Hunts the PowGoop / MuddyC2Go loader family — a MuddyWater signature since 2022 documented by ClearSky, Trend Micro, and Mandiant. The actor drops a legitimate Google-signed binary (GoogleUpdate.exe / googleupdate.exe) into a writable directory next to a malicious goopdate.dll side-load that decrypts a .dat payload and pivots to PowerShell-based C2.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="GoogleUpdate.exe" AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe") by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_path Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(parent_process_path, "(?i)\\\\Program Files( \\(x86\\))?\\\\Google\\\\") | join type=inner host [| tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name="goopdate.dll" by host Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | where NOT match(file_path, "(?i)\\\\Program Files( \\(x86\\))?\\\\Google\\\\")] | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let GoogleDirs = dynamic([@"c:\program files\google\", @"c:\program files (x86)\google\"]);
let SideLoad =
    DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName =~ "goopdate.dll"
    | where not(tolower(FolderPath) startswith @"c:\program files\google\")
    | where not(tolower(FolderPath) startswith @"c:\program files (x86)\google\")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "googleupdate.exe"
    | project LoadTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              GoopDir = FolderPath,
              LoaderPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              LoaderPid = InitiatingProcessId;
let ChildProc =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "googleupdate.exe"
    | where not(tolower(InitiatingProcessFolderPath) startswith @"c:\program files\google\")
    | where not(tolower(InitiatingProcessFolderPath) startswith @"c:\program files (x86)\google\")
    | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe")
    | project SpawnTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ChildFile = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              LoaderPid = InitiatingProcessId, LoaderPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath;
SideLoad
| join kind=inner ChildProc on DeviceId, LoaderPid
| where SpawnTime between (LoadTime - 5m .. LoadTime + 30m)
| project LoadTime, SpawnTime, DeviceName, AccountName,
          GoopDir, LoaderPath, ChildFile, ChildCmd
| order by LoadTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentName = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend ChildName  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ParentName == "googleupdate.exe"
| where not(tolower(ParentProcessName) startswith @"c:\program files\google\")
| where not(tolower(ParentProcessName) startswith @"c:\program files (x86)\google\")
| where ChildName in ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: MuddyWater PowGoop DLL Side-Load — GoogleUpdate.exe Outside Program Files Spawns Script Host
id: 7e1c4d3f-2c83-4b1a-9b71-7a5e62fb12c7
status: experimental
description: Detects MuddyWater PowGoop / MuddyC2Go loader pattern — a legitimate Google-signed binary planted in a non-Program Files directory side-loading goopdate.dll and immediately spawning a script host or LOLBin.
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\GoogleUpdate.exe'
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
  filter_legit_path:
    ParentImage|contains:
      - '\Program Files\Google\'
      - '\Program Files (x86)\Google\'
  condition: selection_parent and not filter_legit_path
fields:
  - ParentImage
  - Image
  - CommandLine
  - User
falsepositives:
  - Custom Google Update test installs in a developer workstation
level: high
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1574.002
  - attack.t1036.005
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.g0069
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\GoogleUpdate.exe OR *\googleupdate.exe OR *\GOOGLEUPDATE.EXE) -@ParentImage:(*\Program?Files\Google\* OR *\Program?Files?(x86)\Google\* OR *\program?files\google\* OR *\program?files?(x86)\google\*) @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\cmd.exe OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\RunDll32.exe OR *\regsvr32.exe OR *\RegSvr32.exe OR *\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/googleupdate\.exe$/i
| NOT (ParentImageFileName=/\\Program Files( \(x86\))?\\Google\\/i)
| ImageFileName=/(powershell|pwsh|cmd|rundll32|regsvr32|mshta)\.exe$/i
| join({
    #event_simpleName=ClassifiedModuleLoad OR #event_simpleName=ImageHash
    | TargetFileName=/goopdate\.dll$/i
    | NOT (TargetFileName=/\\Program Files( \(x86\))?\\Google\\/i)
  }, field=aid, include=[TargetFileName])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentImageFileName, ImageFileName], function=[count(), collect([CommandLine, SHA256HashData])])
| sort(@timestamp, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: PowGoop / MuddyC2Go is the iconic MuddyWater loader — ClearSky, Trend Micro, Mandiant (UNC3313) and Microsoft all attribute it specifically to G0069. The diagnostic combination is (a) a legitimate, Google-signed GoogleUpdate.exe planted outside Program Files, (b) goopdate.dll side-loaded from the same directory, and (c) immediate spawn of powershell.exe / cmd.exe / mshta.exe to bootstrap the C2. N
